terms.p: The compiler quietly turning a reference into a reference to what it derefs to, &String into &str or &Vec<T> into &[T], wherever a function argument or an annotated let asks for the second one.

terms.x: a byte offset you may slice at
terms.p: A byte position in a string that sits at the start of a character rather than in the middle of one, which is the only kind of position a string slice is allowed to begin or end at.
